about:
AccuFab LLC operates as AccuFab Welding & Metal Fabrication from Lincoln, Arkansas. The company provides custom welding and metal fabrication services across Northwest Arkansas. While a founding year is not published, the firm cites over 20 years of hands-on experience in the trade.

The shop produces a range of fabricated metalwork including handrails, guardrails, staircases, deck frames, stainless steel countertops, awnings, signs, and ornamental and structural pieces. It also offers repair services and custom projects. Processes center on welding and metal fabrication; no facility size, headcount, or volume metrics are disclosed.

The company serves residential and commercial customers seeking custom metal fabrication, though specific industry sectors are not listed on its site. Examples from its portfolio include railings, staircases, and stainless steel countertops for both home and business settings.

AccuFab emphasizes dependability, attention to detail, and pride in every weld as its distinguishing traits. It promotes fair pricing and excellent work on every job, backed by two decades of practical experience.
